characteristics.$text:
+1 Res, and Regeneration (4+).
The model loses Light Armour, Metal Armour, and automatically fails all its Armour Saves.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: All units not containing Aura of Madness within 6" of the model benefits from Fearless, Frenzy, Unruly. Friendly units engaged in the same Combined Combat as the model with Aura of Madness automatically pass their Primal Instinct tests.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: One Phase.
May be activated during Choose Equipment and Abilities.
Rank-and-File model parts with Wildhorn in the bearer’s unit have their Str set to 4 and their AP set to 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Looted Booze. One use only: this weapon can be used as a Shooting Weapon with the following profile.
After this weapon has been used as a Shooting Weapon, the model loses Looted Booze.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The target gains +2" Adv and +3 Agi.

No model can be affected by more than one Totem Bound Spell simultaneously: only apply the effects of the most recently successfully cast one.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: A unit that contains a Character with Blood Offering may reroll failed Panic Tests at the cost of inflicting one HP loss on a Character with Blood Offering in the unit.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The target gains +1 Att and Melee Attacks gain +2 AP.

No model can be affected by more than one Totem Bound Spell simultaneously: only apply the effects of the most recently successfully cast one.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
A model part with a Breath Attack can use it as a Shooting Weapon in the Shooting Phase or as a Melee Attack in the Melee Phase. If a model has more than one Breath Attack, it can only use one in a single phase.
  • When used as a Shooting Weapon, the attack has a range of 6". It can be used even if the model Marched previously in this Player Turn.
  • When used as a Melee Attack, the attack is made at the model part’s Agility in addition to its normal Close Combat Attacks. Declare that you are using the Breath Attack when allocating attacks, and choose a model in base contact to attack with it. When used in this way, it still counts as firing a shot for the purpose of Slow Reload. No matter if it is used as a Shooting Weapon or Melee Attack, the target of the Breath Attack suffers a single hit. The Strength, Armour Penetration and Attack Attributes (if any) of these hits are given within the brackets of the model rule as X, Y and Z. For example: Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 1, Flaming Attacks, Slow Reload).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The target gains Hard Target (1), Magic Resistance (3).

No model can be affected by more than one Totem Bound Spell simultaneously: only apply the effects of the most recently successfully cast one.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
The wearer gains First Strike (Stubborn), and the wearer’s unit gains Unruly.
In addition, all units entirely with Unruly within range of the wearer’s Commanding Presence (if applicable) gain First Strike (Stubborn).

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A Charging model with this Attribute, or using a weapon with this Attribute, gains the Model Rules and Characteristic modifiers stated in brackets (X). For example, a Charging model part with Devastating Charge (+1 Strength, Poison Attacks) gains +1 Strength and Poison Attacks when it is Charging. This rule is cumulative: a model part with several instances of Devastating Charge applies all Attack Attributes and Characteristics modifiers from all of them when Charging.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Devastating Charge (+1 Str, +1 AP), Fearless, Unruly.
Drunk units cannot choose to Ambush.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The unit gains one of two sets of effects depending on whether it shows up Sober or Drunk on the Battlefield.
During Pre-game Selections, each unit containing Drunkard must choose whether it is Sober or Drunk.
Drunk Characters cannot join units containing any Sober models and vice versa (models without Drunkard are considered neither Drunk nor Sober). Sober () The model gains Light Troops, Vanguard.
A unit that has been Sober at any point during the game is never considered Scoring.Drunk () The model gains Devastating Charge (+1 Str, +1 AP), Fearless, Unruly.
Drunk units cannot choose to Ambush.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The target gains Fearless.
In addition, it may immediately perform a Magical Move (5 Mar).
This spell may target units in Ambush. If so, the target unit immediately enters the Battlefied following normal Ambush rules, instead of performing a Magical Move.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
For each Standard Melee Attack allocated against the wielder’s model that results in a to-hit roll of ‘1’, the wielder must perform a Standard Melee Attack at the end of the same Agility Step, before any casualties are removed.
This overrides the normal restriction that Beast Axe attacks always strike at Agility Step 0.
This attack must be allocated towards the model’s Health Pool that rolled the ‘1’ to hit, and it does not count against the number of attacks the wielder’s model can make due to Restricted Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Drunkard, Strider (Forest).
At the end of a friendly Movement Phase, if the model is in contact with a Forest, it may lose all its current weapons and gain Uprooted Tree, with Duration: Permanent.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The target gains +1 Arm and Distracting (1).

No model can be affected by more than one Totem Bound Spell simultaneously: only apply the effects of the most recently successfully cast one.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains all four Bound Spells from the list below, with Range 18".

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Fury, Dying Blow.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
If the Army List includes a model with Hunting Call, the owner may reroll Ambush rolls of ‘1’ and ‘2’.
If the owner has the second Player Turn, any unit containing Pack Tactics may choose to roll for its Ambush starting from Player Turn 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Friendly units within 6" of one or more models with Hunting Horn benefit from +1" Charge Speed.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
At Initiative Step 10, a Charging model part with Impact Hits must choose an enemy model in base contact. This model suffers a number of hits equal to the value stated in brackets (X). These hits are resolved with the attacking model part’s Strength and Armour Penetration, unless otherwise specified.
If a model has both Grind Attack and Impact Hits, it may only use one of these rules in the same Round of Combat (the owner may choose which).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
One use only. May be activated at the start of any Player Turn.
All models with Drunkard in the model’s unit change their state from Sober to Drunk.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Charge Range rolls made towards an enemy unit’s Flank or Rear Facing are Maximised.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: All friendly units of Raiding Chariots, Razortusks, and Razortusk Chariots, excluding Characters, within 12" of the bearer gain Vanguard.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
During Choose Equipment and Abilities, each unit containing this Attack Attribute must take a Courage Test.
If the test is passed, all model parts with Primal Instinct in the unit gain Hatred, with Duration: Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: One Turn.
If the bearer is on the Battlefield, this item is automatically activated at the start of the first Game Turn; if not, it has no effect.
All Ranged Attacks suffer −1 to hit.

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: Permanent.
During Pre-game Selections, place a Forest:
  • Touching your Deployment Zone.
  • Not in contact with any Terrain Feature . This Forest is a 10"6" rectangle, that can not be chosen for Primary or Secondary Objectives.
Friendly units entirely with Pack Tactics treat this Forest as part of their Deployment Zone for the purpose of where they can be Deployed.
A unit that starts the game in contact with this Forest cannot declare a Charge in the first Player Turn of the first Game Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Starting on Game Turn 1, a model with Sleeper may decide whether its arrival from Ambush succeeds or fails, without rolling.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Light Troops, Vanguard.
A unit that has been Sober at any point during the game is never considered Scoring.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A model part with Stomp Attack can make a Special Attack which is resolved at Agility Step 0, can only be allocated towards a Health Pool of Height 0–1, and inflicts X hits, using the model part’s Strength, Armour Penetration and Attack Attributes, but not Weapons. If more than one model part of a combined model has Stomp Attack, only a single model part (chosen by the model’s owner) can perform its Stomp Attack in each Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Standard Melee Attacks that roll a ‘6’ to wound gain Multiple Wounds (D3).
If at least one such attack causes an HP loss, this model Recovers 1 HP at the end of the Agility Step (unless it was removed as a casualty).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Wizard (0; Totems). The model cannot learn the Hereditary Spell.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The unit gains a single Bound Spell chosen from the list below, which must be noted on the Army List.
When casting the spell, choose one Rank-and-File model in the unit as the model casting the spell.
The spell can only target the unit itself.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
Lethal Strike. Every time a Standard Melee Attack made with this weapon rolls a ‘6’ to wound and causes a HP loss, the wielder may Recover 1 HP at the end of current the Agility Step (unless their model was removed as a casualty).
Only 1 HP can be regained per phase with this item.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with this weapon gain Automatic Hits and always have Str 5 and AP 0.

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text:
During Choose Equipment and Abilities, the bearer may gain either of the following, with Duration: Round of Combat:
  • −1 Res, +1 Str, +1 AP
  • +1 Res, −1 Str, −1 AP
